bio: Located just above the village, the Hotel Bergblick not only boasts charming guestrooms and attractive spa facilities, but also has a culinary dimension that is well worth exploring. Opening onto the lobby, bar and lounge, this elegant little restaurant skilfully brings a modern touch to regional style. Large windows afford views of the mountains, as does the terrace. The set menu changes every month and showcases select ingredients and successfully, seamlessly integrating Asian influences. The petits fours are a wonderful finale to the meal. The service is friendly and professional – the enthusiastic chef takes the time to describe his creations tableside. Decent wine list dominated by Austrian labels.
